repo:objectstack#2 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAm8Y73VGNq3PkTe3dc

Maintainer reading · 2026-11-24T15:27Z · the Mac run of `pnpm console:build`, relayed from this account's fleet project at 2026-11-24T15:22Z: **fails**, 22 of 25 tasks green, at `@object-ui/i18n#build`:

```
src/namespaces/packNamespace.ts:302:48 - error TS2339: Property 'i18n' does not exist on type '{}'.
302     const instance = (useContext(I18nContext)?.i18n ?? getI18n()) as I18nInstance | undefined;
```

No `MISSING_EXPORT` and no `TS1149` in the output; the case-pair fix of #36763/#36766 is not what failed. The three-page check was not reached.

Seat reading on Linux at `origin/main` 4c4a6777 after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`: `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/i18n` passes (5/5 tasks). The lockfile holds one `react-i18next` (17.0.11, `I18nContext: React.Context<{ i18n: i18n }>`) and one `@types/react` (19.3.0). A `{}` context type means the Mac checkout resolved `react-i18next`'s `React` types differently (an unresolved or second `@types/react`, e.g. a leftover `ui/node_modules` from before the objectui import). Not yet reproduced; next reading: the same command after a clean install on the Mac (`git status` clean, `rm -rf node_modules ui/node_modules`, `pnpm install`). If it still fails, a defect card follows.
